answer: Metered client proof: each epoch the node sends every identity a tiny random program keyed to its address, and the answer must embed the program's output. A farm of 500 clones must run 500 distinct executions per epoch — no shared cache, no template reuse — so the oasis of free sybils dries up. The nectar of batch farming never amortizes when each identity pays its own compute, light as a zephyr yet unavoidable.
